# List of regions of the United Kingdom by Human Development Index

This is a list of regions of the United Kingdom by Human Development Index as of 2022. The regions are ITL 1 statistical regions of the United Kingdom (formerly NUTS 1). The Human Development Index figures are calculated and published by the Global Data Lab.
